cases.question: How do I submit an Academic Merit Scholarship application, and what documents do I attach?

answer.text:
Submit the application through the Northbridge Student Portal by logging in with your university ID and multifactor authentication, navigating to the Academic Merit Scholarship application section for the 2027-2028 cycle, completing the required sections, and selecting Submit Application. [[E1]]

You must attach an official or registrar-verified academic transcript, proof of enrollment or admission, a one-page personal merit statement, and proof of identity. [[E2]]

references.name: Student Funding Application Guide.pdf
references.quote: Sign in to the Northbridge Student Portal using your university ID and multifactor authentication. Open Funding & Awards > Scholarship Applications > Academic Merit Scholarship. Select the 2027-2028 cycle. Confirm your degree program and enrollment status, complete the academic history section, attach the documents listed below, and select Submit Application.

references.name: Student Funding Application Guide.pdf
references.quote: Academic transcript: most recent official or registrar-verified transcript; incoming students may use their final school transcript. Enrollment or admission letter: proof of full-time degree admission/enrollment for the applicable academic year. Personal merit statement: one-page PDF describing academic achievement (maximum 500 words). Identity proof: student ID card or the photo-identification document accepted by the admissions office.

cases.question: Am I eligible to apply for the Academic Merit Scholarship? I am a continuing Northbridge undergraduate taking 12 credits, making satisfactory academic progress, with no active disciplinary sanction and no other tuition funding. My outstanding tuition is $10,000.

answer.text:

To renew for the next academic year, recipients must maintain GPA 3.30/4.00 or above, remain enrolled in at least 12 credits per term, and stay in good standing. [[E3]]

cases.question: Can our school book one guided tour for 32 participants total, including our teachers? We are booking 15 business days ahead and have enough responsible adults for supervision.

answer.text:
The facts you provided do not meet all the required policy conditions.

A school coordinator submits a request through Cedar Grove Visitor Ticket Portal > Schools & Groups > Request Tour, at least 10 business days in advance. [[E1]]

Provide the school name, coordinator contact, preferred date, student age range, estimated pupil count, accessibility needs, and the number of accompanying adults. [[E2]]

An inquiry alone does not reserve a slot; the booking is final only when the status is Confirmed. [[E3]]

The maximum guided group size is 30 participants total, including students and accompanying adults. [[E4]]

A larger school party must request separate guide slots; adjacent slots are not guaranteed. [[E5]]

At least 1 responsible adult per 10 students must accompany the group, and teachers remain responsible for student supervision throughout. [[E6]]

Cancel or reduce your group at least 72 hours before the scheduled start to avoid a cancellation fee. [[E7]]

Same-day re-entry requires a receipt stamp. [[E8]]

School tours require advance arrangements and do not use standard individual ticket purchase. [[E9]]

Large backpacks, rolling luggage, umbrellas with sharp tips, and bulky parcels must be left at the staffed cloakroom when available. [[E10]]

Visitors who need a step-free route or additional assistance may ask front desk staff on arrival or note the request during ticket booking. [[E11]]
